decisions.text: Coordinator explicitly dropped the unreachable referee-supplied adaptation acceptance sub-case: evolution-off newGame creates no adaptations and the fixed referee seam cannot create cards or edit rules. The Evolution is off guard remains and deck exclusion/no-specialization behavior is tested; no referee op or optional type field was added.
Each Carbon Bacteria adds a bonus equal to the C each worker owner actually released that phase; this bonus does not reduce biomass. Nitrifying and Phosphorus Bacteria award their own owners.
Drawn events are held outside deck/discard until their replacement draw chain ends so edited event-only decks terminate; all events then go to discard and remain available for later reshuffles.

gaps: Independent documentation/code review remains outstanding with the coordinator at the wave gate; Alley deterministic review found no policy changes, proposals or uncommitted store changes.
